title: National Career Service (NCS) Job Portal
target_audience: Job seekers across all education levels (10th pass, graduates, skilled technicians).
benefits: Free job search matching across thousands of private and government vacancies, free career counseling, and job fair alerts without middleman fees.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen searching for full-time, part-time, or contract employment.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Educational Marksheets, Mobile number, Resume/Experience details.
how_to_apply: Register profile online at ncs.gov.in or visit local Model Career Centre (MCC) / District Employment Exchange.

title: MGNREGA 100-Day Wage Employment Guarantee
target_audience: Rural adult household members willing to do unskilled manual labor.
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per financial year per household. Wages paid directly to bank/post office account within 15 days.
eligibility: Adult members of rural households applying to local Gram Panchayat.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Passport photo of household members, Bank/Post Office account details.
how_to_apply: Submit written or verbal application to Gram Panchayat for Job Card issuance (free of cost).

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
target_audience: ITI holders, diploma holders, graduates, and 10th/12th pass youth.
benefits: Paid on-the-job industrial apprenticeship with monthly stipend (₹7,000 to ₹15,000) sharing from Government of India, leading to permanent job opportunities.
eligibility: Minimum 14 years of age with required educational criteria for chosen trade.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Bank Details, ITI/Degree Marksheet.
how_to_apply: Register at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and apply for open vacancies in nearby manufacturing and service industries.

title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
target_audience: Entrepreneurs and youth setting up new micro-enterprises, small shops, or manufacturing units.
benefits: Bank loans up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing units and ₹20 Lakh for service units, with government subsidy of 15% to 35% on project cost.
eligibility: Individuals aged 18+, SHGs, cooperatives. Minimum 8th pass for projects above ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Project Report (DPR), Educational certificate, Caste/Special category certificate, Bank passbook.
how_to_apply: Apply online at kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal with target bank details.

title: e-Shram Portal for Unorganized & Gig Workers
target_audience: Construction workers, gig workers, domestic helpers, street vendors, and drivers.
benefits: Universal Account Number (UAN) card for social security welfare schemes, accident insurance cover under PMSBY, and direct disaster relief aid.
eligibility: Unorganized workers aged 16-59 who are not members of EPFO or ESIC and not income tax payers.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card linked with Mobile Number, Bank Account details.
how_to_apply: Self-register on eshram.gov.in or visit any nearest CSC kiosk.

title: Basic Resume Writing & Job Interview Preparation Tips
target_audience: First-time job seekers and entry-level candidates.
benefits: Guidelines on crafting a clean 1-page bio-data/resume, highlighting phone number, skills, past experience, and answering interview questions with confidence.
eligibility: All candidates preparing for private or government sector interviews.
how_to_apply: Keep resume concise (1-2 pages), practice introducing yourself in 60 seconds ('Tell me about yourself'), dress neatly, and reach 15 minutes before scheduled time.

title: Stand-Up India Scheme for Women and SC/ST Entrepreneurs
target_audience: Women and SC/ST individuals establishing greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for setting up manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or trading businesses.
eligibility: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs above 18 years of age. At least 51% shareholding held by woman/SC/ST.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Category certificate, Project report, Bank KYC, Business premises proof.
how_to_apply: Apply online at standupmitra.in or directly through any commercial bank branch.

title: Pradhan Mantri National Apprenticeship & Rozgar Melas
target_audience: Job seekers seeking immediate spot interviews and appointment letters.
benefits: Direct face-to-face spot interviews with 50+ private employers and government contractors under one roof in your district.
documents_needed: Multiple copies of Resume/Biodata, Passport photos, Aadhaar, Original marksheets.
how_to_apply: Check schedule on ncs.gov.in or visit district employment exchange on designated Rozgar Mela dates.

title: DDU-GKY (Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana)
target_audience: Poor rural youth aged 15-35 looking for placement-linked skilling.
benefits: Free residential training with food, accommodation, uniform, and guaranteed minimum 70% job placement in private sector.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, BPL/SECC proof or MGNREGA Job Card of parent, Educational certificate.
how_to_apply: Contact Gram Panchayat or visit ddugky.gov.in to find affiliated training partners.

title: e-Migrate System for Safe Overseas Employment
target_audience: Workers seeking jobs abroad (Gulf countries, Southeast Asia, Europe).
benefits: Protects migrant workers from fake visa agents, ensures verified employment contracts, minimum wage standards, and Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana coverage.
eligibility: Indian citizens holding ECR (Emigration Check Required) or non-ECR passports.
documents_needed: Valid Passport, Verified Employment Contract, Medical Fitness certificate, Visa.
how_to_apply: Always check registered recruiting agents on emigrate.gov.in before paying any money.
